title: D3CODE: Disentangling Disagreements in Data across Cultures on Offensiveness Detection and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing parallel annotations of offensive language from 4,309 annotators across 21 countries and 8 geo-cultural regions to measure regional variations and disagreements in offensiveness perception.
Clustering annotators based on their self-reported values using the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-2) and evaluating in-group homogeneity versus cross-group disagreement on subjective text.
Analyzing differences in annotation certainty and the likelihood of expressing a lack of understanding of the text based on the annotators' age groups.
Evaluating differences in annotation certainty and the rate at which different self-reported gender groups state a lack of understanding of the annotated messages.

bias_targets.target: Social group bias (Religious, Sexual orientation, Gender identity)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cross-regional and inter-annotator disagreement specifically on text items mentioning social identity groups (e.g., Christian, Jewish, Muslim, LGB, Transgender).
